name: Meta Muse Code
description: Meta's first AI coding agent - a terminal-based tool for macOS and Linux designed for handling large codebases and complex software projects. It can plan changes, write code, validate results, and coordinate subagents for complex tasks.
community_quotes: Meta's first coding agent to take on Anthropic and OpenAI

name: Smaug-Agentic
description: Abacus.AI's open-source agentic coding model - a fine-tune of Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 (2.8T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model), positioned as the top open-weight model for agentic coding tasks.
community_quotes: THE TOP OPEN SOURCE MODEL IN THE WORLD FOR AGENTIC CODING
Built on Kimi K3 MoE architecture

name: GitHub AI Code Coverage
description: GitHub's new AI-assisted code coverage setup feature in Public Preview. AI can automatically generate coverage workflows and assist with configuration within the repository's Code Quality settings.
community_quotes: GitHub AI can now automatically generate coverage workflows
Part of GitHub's move toward governed, measurable, auditable AI
Available in Public Preview for Code Quality Team
